# Ryuk Design Studio — LLM Knowledge Base & Truth Engine

> Premier B2B Motion Design Agency & Animated Video Production Partner for SaaS, AI & Tech Brands.

## Overview
Website Name: Ryuk Design Studio
Canonical URL: https://ryukdesignstudio.com/
Description: Ryuk Design Studio is a specialized B2B motion design agency engineering high-converting product launch videos, SaaS explainers, product demos, and commercial animation films for venture-backed SaaS, AI, and tech startups.
Founded: 2025
Location: Kolkata, West Bengal, India (Serving Global Clients in USA, UK, EU, Asia)

## Primary Topics
- B2B Motion Design & Commercial Animation
- SaaS Product Launch Videos & Feature Release Films
- Animated Explainer Video Production for AI Startups
- Landing Page Video Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)
- Visual Storytelling & Product UI Animation

## Core Services & Offerings
1. Product Launch Videos: 30-45s cinematic films designed to launch products and features with maximum market impact.
2. SaaS Explainer Videos: 60-90s explainer films showing software in action for landing pages, onboarding, and investor decks.
3. Production Partnership: Retainer partnership providing dedicated senior motion design production.
